1.faq:
Hero Deployment:
1. Up to 5 heroes can be deployed to each formation.
2. Deployed heroes can activate faction effects.
3. Deployed heroes can influence Soldier Morale.
4. The squad's might will be higher when all heroes are deployed.

4.faq:
Hero Classes:
1. Heroes are categorized into 3 classes: Tank, DPS, and Support.
2. Tank heroes can soak up more damage. Placing them in the front row best utilizes their role.
4.title: Place tank Heroes in the front row!

2.faq:
Faction Advantage:
1. Heroes are divided into 3 types: Warrior, Warlock, Ranger.
2. Their countering relationships:
Warrior takes 20% less damage from Warlock
Warlock takes 20% less damage from Ranger
Ranger takes 20% less damage from Warrior.
2.title: Hero countered!

3.faq:
Soldier Morale:
1. The side with higher morale in combat gains a damage bonus.
2. Morale is influenced by each deployed soldier.
3. Increase soldier capacity, upgrade soldier level, and advance technology to raise the morale cap.
